entities.summary: Humour is a complex and multifaceted concept that has been a cornerstone of human expression and interaction for thousands of years. Its origins are unclear, but it is believed to have emerged in ancient civilizations as a way to cope with the challenges and absurdities of life. Through the ages, humour has been used to entertain, to critique, and to bring people together. From the plays of Aristophanes to the satirical cartoons of modern-day newspapers, humour has played a vital role in shaping our culture and our society. Despite its many forms and expressions, humour remains a universal language that transcends borders and cultures, allowing us to connect with others and find meaning in the world around us.
